scope: Additive source-only repair of the M1016 packed-psum packing/cycle disconnect. M1056 retains M1016 task and pipeline event geometry, assigns physical packed-group addresses, deterministically serializes every group through one 1RW FIFO, enforces RAW dependencies, and propagates delayed operations through task completion, downstream work start, and sample commit. This contract authorizes no full frozen-row replay, EDA, GPU, remote work, capacity admission, speedup, or paper claim.

event_and_dependency_semantics.task_event_geometry: For each task use the frozen M1016 span=max(1,work/8 floor), bank read at work_start+bank*span, and bank write at min(nominal_work_end,read+span-1).
event_and_dependency_semantics.write_dependency: A write enters arbitration only after its current-task read plus the nominal read-to-write distance.
event_and_dependency_semantics.raw_dependency: A read of a packed group/address cannot grant until at least one cycle after the preceding program-order write to that address.
event_and_dependency_semantics.one_port_rule: At most one read or write grant per packed macro group per cycle, independent of address.
event_and_dependency_semantics.input_order: Caller list order has no authority; arrival cycle then program order determines FIFO order.
event_and_dependency_semantics.event_conservation: Every generated read and write must receive exactly one grant.

backpressure_semantics.task_effective_end: max(nominal_work_end, all actual psum write grant cycles)
backpressure_semantics.next_task_work_start: max(previous effective work end, previous work start + current preprocess cycles) + 2
backpressure_semantics.sample_cycles_after_commit: sample cycles before commit + frozen commit cycles
backpressure_semantics.reason: Serialization may consume existing slack or cascade into later readiness and completion; excess-access count is not a cycle penalty.

separate_gates.port_feasibility_pass_definition: all accesses conserved, one grant/group/cycle, RAW dependencies satisfied, and all task/commit delays propagated

covers: no-conflict identity with M1016 pipeline recurrence
delay cascade into next task and commit
rejection of simple cycles plus conflict count

m1057_adversarial_requirements: recompute every small-oracle anchor without trusting returned booleans
inject multiplicity 2 and 3 at the same packed group/cycle
reverse caller event order and require the same grants
prove different addresses still serialize on one group port
prove same-address RAW cannot pass its predecessor write
prove delayed write changes downstream work start and commit
reject dependency cycles, duplicate IDs and duplicate program order
reject asymmetric service receipts or arbiter resources
reject a caller-supplied capacity or port-feasibility pass
prove no code path computes corrected cycles as raw cycles plus 403922
verify M1051 and docs359 frozen identities
verify no full-result or attempt namespace was created
